HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Planning Family Meals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Planning Family Meals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Planning Family Meals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Planning Family Meals.

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cake Making and Decoration? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cake Making and Decoration.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cake Making and Decoration.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cake Making and Decoration.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cake Making and Decoration.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meal Service? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meal Service.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meal Service.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Meal Service.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meal Service.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Preservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Preservation.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Planning Family Meals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Meal Service and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Food Preservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cake Making and Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
